summary: Tested the Knowledge Gate Protocol through POST /api/chat/send on the public Preview URL with instance 88bfae82-2533-4235-968d-b3298fd57073. Its KB has a 132-char FAQ 'Gridscan API' plus a URL source 'Cardano Accounts API · docs' that holds only its 27-char title, so the scrape was effectively empty. Created 6 pytest LLM tests and ran the suite twice, 6/6 passing both times. The partial-topic test was run 3 more times and passed each time. KB question: confident answer citing GET /accounts/{address} with no hedging. Blockfrost/Koios: 'I don't have information about that in my knowledge base.' with no details about either service. Capital of France: refused, no 'Paris'. Transaction/NFT on Gridscan, rate limits/auth, and alternative Cardano APIs: all refused without adding general knowledge or naming other services. No response contained 'general AI training', 'training knowledge' or 'training data'.

minor.issue: Small inferences remain: (1) the KB answer once built a full URL 'https://ada.gridscan.io/accounts/{address}'. The KB only gives the path, and the docs source is ada.api.gridscan.io, so the host may be wrong. (2) One refusal listed '❌ Smart contract interaction', which was not asked about and is not in the KB. Neither added outside facts, but both go slightly beyond the KB.

Answers are inconsistent: sometimes the reply starts with 'I don't have information...', other times it starts with a markdown header and puts the refusal sentence lower down. Refusals also often restate KB content and offer help with Gridscan. This is acceptable but not strictly 'say it and stop'.

action_items: Optional: add a prompt line such as 'Do not construct URLs, hosts, or examples that are not literally in the KB' to stop the host/URL guessing.
Optional: tell the model to put the refusal sentence first and keep refusals short, without markdown headers, for consistency.
Note: the 'Cardano Accounts API · docs' URL source holds only its title (27 chars). The scrape effectively failed, so consider re-scraping it.
critical_code_review_comments: search_knowledge() falls back to loading ALL active sources when $text search finds nothing. knowledge_context is therefore never empty when a KB exists, and the 'No matching entries' branch of build_system_prompt only runs if search_knowledge raises an exception. As a result, off-topic refusals depend entirely on the LLM following the KNOWLEDGE GATE text. This works today, but it is a prompt-only guarantee.
search_knowledge() returns '' when it catches an exception. The bot then answers with a 'no info' refusal instead of showing an error, which can hide database or index failures from admins.
server.py is a single very large file (well over 700 lines). It should be split into modules.
seed_data_creation: None. Chat test conversations were saved with session_ids prefixed 'TEST_kg_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> pytest backend/tests/test_knowledge_gate.py -s. The tests depend on instance 88bfae82-... keeping its Gridscan FAQ. The LLM tests are not deterministic, and the assertions use keyword checks for refusal markers and leaked terms.
